headline: OMNITUBE 1.4.4: thousands of ElevenLabs voices, batch images and clearer setup
notes: ElevenLabs Voice Library: browse 20,000+ voices, filter by gender, language and use, hear a sample and add the one you want
Pictures now appear on the storyboard the moment they are ready, no more switching tabs
Batch: tick several scenes and remake their pictures in one run
New All to video button turns every scene into a video scene at once
PCs without an NVIDIA card get a clear message and a one-click switch to Cloud instead of a failed start
Older NVIDIA cards (GTX 10 series and Quadro P) now say why they cannot run the picture engine
Ollama now starts by itself, so Smart Director and the face describer just work
Reset to recommended in Settings puts picture size, video size and clip length back to what suits your PC
Pro licenses are now checked with Gumroad. Your key from the Gumroad email works on one PC, and fake keys no longer work
